When he reached another room, the news was talking about another successful rescue of Spider-Man, but almost every scientist there was looking at Gabriel.*

  "What are these faces? They look like they've never seen Spider-Man saving people."  *Gabriel commented, but his attention turned to the screen that showed something he had suspected for a long time.*

  **You, the person Gabriel loved most, were kissing Spider-Man in front of the cameras.**
